text.text_excerpt: Going through the drive-through for a quick dinner after holiday shopping for quite a few hours! I was tired and they were relatively quick with two people in front of me. If I'm eating by myself I usually get the fried shrimp, french fries, bicuit, extra tartar sauce and diet coke (ironic since it's a chicken joint and the diet coke DOES eliminate all the fat I eat! hehe). But since I was with my Mom we ordered a three piece dinner (we don't eat a lot) and extra red beans and rice and extra biscuit for me. After eating Popeye's my entire life. I am addicted to the sides such as the buttermilk biscuits, red beans and rice, mashed potatoes and gracy, cajun fries, dirty rice (it's not cajun...

Great but extremely slow service via walk-in. It's like the inside of the store is em-----pty and it takes 45.9 mins to get your food. This is a phenomenon that I cannot understand. Cars in the drive thru that was hanging out in the street has ordered, picked up and driven away and I'm still in there waiting. I get it, Jesus doesn't want me to have that greasy, high cholesterol laced delicacy LOL. That bird is something else tho. Talking about an intervention?? Whelp, I'm leaving Popeye's alone for a while and focusing on the 10 Day Green Smoothie Cleanse by JJ Smith. Wish me the best, it's a first!

The five stars is ONLY for the food! The customer service was annoying and rude. I was greeted w/ a "May I help you?" Rude as hell. I had to adjust my attitude before I responded. The lady responded again w/ a "Welcome to Popeye's, how may I help you?" By the time, I was already over it. The face I was greeted with at the window didn't make it any better. However! When I got home, I opened my box and was pleased. My food was hot and fresh, although I was expecting the worst based off of the customer service.
